eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Elko, NV; at 9:13 PM on AUG 29, 2017 Effective until 1:13 AM AUG 30, 2017. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
Notice: The following areas should prepare for a possible evacuation due to a wild land fire on Lower Lamoille Road - Hog Tommy and Green Crest Roads.  
Areas include: The Marina Area - Bellwood, Blackstone, lower Lamoille Road, Hog Tommy and Green Crest. Sheriff Deputies may be arriving at your door; please be ready to evacuate upon notice.
